lyrics_set.lyrics:
[Intro]
[Verse]
Tracing shadows on the velvet floor
Waiting for a knock upon the door
A silver moon hangs in the sky
Watching all the city secrets fly
[Pre-Chorus]
One glass remains upon the tray
Chasing all the ghosts of day
[Chorus]
Midnight is a velvet gown
Spinning through the smoky town
Dancing in a golden light
Lost within the rhythm of the night
[Verse]
A saxophone begins to softly weep
Secrets that the morning shadows keep
Ticking clocks and hats upon the stand
Time is slipping through a steady hand
[Pre-Chorus]
The melody begins to soar
Finding what the heart is searching for
[Chorus]
Midnight is a velvet gown
Spinning through the smoky town
Dancing in a golden light
Lost within the rhythm of the night
[Instrumental]
[Bridge]
The brass begins to swell and rise
A sudden spark before the dreamer's eyes
[Chorus]
Midnight is a velvet gown
Spinning through the smoky town
Dancing in a golden light
Lost within the rhythm of the night
[Outro]
